response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), grand AS (SELECT SUM(invoiced) AS total FROM color_totals), avg_color AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_invoiced FROM color_totals), above_avg AS (SELECT c.color, c.invoiced, c.invoiced * 1.0 / g.total AS share, c.invoiced - a.avg_invoiced AS above_by FROM color_totals c CROSS JOIN grand g CROSS JOIN avg_color a WHERE c.invoiced > a.avg_invoiced) SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(above_by) AS avg_amount_above_average FROM above_avg;
